mapper.select: select dept_id companyDeptId,dept_name companyName from sys_dept where parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0' order by order_num,dept_id
select dept_id companyDeptId,dept_name companyName,leader_user_id leaderUserId from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and parent_id=100 and del_flag='0' and status='0'
select dept_id companyDeptId,leader_user_id leaderUserId from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyDeptId} for update
select tenant_key from biz_feishu_identity_scope where tenant_key=#{tenantKey} for update
mapper.sql: c.connection_id connectionId,c.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,c.tenant_key tenantKey,c.source_timezone timezone,c.state,c.version,c.effective_date effectiveDate,c.last_complete_at lastCompleteAt,c.last_complete_run_id lastCompleteRunId,c.running_run_id runningRunId,c.lease_until leaseUntil,c.created_at createdAt
mapper.select: select from biz_feishu_connection c left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=c.company_dept_id order by c.connection_id
select from biz_feishu_connection c left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=c.company_dept_id where c.connection_id=#{connectionId}

select c.connection_id connectionId,c.company_dept_id companyDeptId,c.tenant_key tenantKey,c.source_timezone timezone,c.state,c.version,c.effective_date effectiveDate,c.last_complete_at lastCompleteAt,c.last_complete_run_id lastCompleteRunId,c.running_run_id runningRunId,c.lease_until leaseUntil,c.created_at createdAt from biz_feishu_connection c where c.connection_id=#{connectionId} for update

select c.connection_id connectionId,c.company_dept_id companyDeptId,c.tenant_key tenantKey,c.source_timezone timezone,c.state,c.version,c.effective_date effectiveDate,c.last_complete_at lastCompleteAt,c.last_complete_run_id lastCompleteRunId,c.running_run_id runningRunId,c.lease_until leaseUntil,c.created_at createdAt from biz_feishu_connection c where c.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} for update
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_connection set state='ACTIVE',effective_date=#{effectiveDate},version=version+1 where connection_id=#{connectionId} and version=#{version} and state='PARALLEL' and running_run_id is null
mapper.select: select u.user_id userId,u.del_flag delFlag,p.employment_status employmentStatus,c.dept_id companyDeptId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName from sys_user u left join biz_staff_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id and d.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept c on c.parent_id=100 and c.del_flag='0' and (c.dept_id=d.dept_id or find_in_set(c.dept_id,d.ancestors)) where u.user_id=#{userId}

select u.user_id userId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName,c.dept_name companyName from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id and d.del_flag='0' join sys_dept c on c.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and c.parent_id=100 and (d.dept_id=c.dept_id or find_in_set(c.dept_id,d.ancestors)) where u.del_flag='0' order by u.user_id limit 2000
mapper.sql: m.mapping_id mappingId,m.connection_id connectionId,m.user_id userId,m.external_user_id externalUserId,m.identity_type identityType,m.effective_from effectiveFrom,m.effective_to effectiveTo,m.status,m.created_by createdBy,m.created_at createdAt,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName
mapper.select: select from biz_feishu_mapping m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.connection_id=#{connectionId} order by m.user_id,m.effective_from,m.mapping_id
select from biz_feishu_mapping m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.mapping_id=#{mappingId}

select count(*) from biz_feishu_mapping m join biz_feishu_connection c on c.connection_id=m.connection_id where (m.connection_id=#{connectionId} or c.tenant_key=#{tenantKey}) and (m.user_id=#{userId} or m.external_user_id=#{externalUserId}) and m.effective_from <= coalesce(#{effectiveTo},'9999-12-31') and coalesce(m.effective_to,'9999-12-31') >= #{effectiveFrom}
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_mapping set effective_to=#{effectiveTo},status='RETIRED',retired_by=#{actorId},retired_at=sysdate() where mapping_id=#{mappingId} and status='CONFIRMED'
mapper.select: select cast(business_date as char) from biz_feishu_observation where mapping_id=#{mappingId} order by business_date desc limit 1 for update

select count(*) from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join biz_staff_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag='0' and coalesce(p.employment_status,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' and (d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors)) and not exists(select 1 from biz_feishu_mapping m where m.connection_id=#{connectionId} and m.user_id=u.user_id and m.effective_from <= #{effectiveDate} and (m.effective_to is null or m.effective_to >= #{effectiveDate}))

select count(*) from biz_staff_leave_request l left join biz_project p on p.project_id=l.submitted_project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=l.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where l.status in ('PENDING','CANCEL_PENDING') and (p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors))

select count(*) from biz_staff_leave_request l left join biz_project p on p.project_id=l.submitted_project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=l.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where l.status='APPROVED' and l.leave_end_date >= #{effectiveDate} and (p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors))
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_connection set running_run_id=#{runId},lease_until=date_add(sysdate(),interval 30 minute) where connection_id=#{connectionId} and (running_run_id is null or lease_until < sysdate())

update biz_feishu_sync_run set status=#{status},finished_at=sysdate(),received_count=#{receivedCount},rejected_count=#{rejectedCount},completed_chunks=#{completedChunks},expected_chunks=#{expectedChunks},error_code=#{errorCode} where run_id=#{runId} and status='RUNNING'
update biz_feishu_connection set running_run_id=null,lease_until=null ,last_complete_at=sysdate(),last_complete_run_id=#{runId} where connection_id=#{connectionId} and running_run_id=#{runId}
mapper.sql: run_id runId,connection_id connectionId,mapping_version mappingVersion,window_start windowStart,window_end windowEnd,status,started_at startedAt,finished_at finishedAt,started_by startedBy,received_count receivedCount,rejected_count rejectedCount,completed_chunks completedChunks,expected_chunks expectedChunks,error_code errorCode
mapper.select: select from biz_feishu_sync_run where connection_id=#{connectionId} order by run_id desc limit 100
select from biz_feishu_sync_run where run_id=#{runId}
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_sync_run set expected_chunks=#{expectedChunks} where run_id=#{runId} and status='RUNNING'
update biz_feishu_sync_run set completed_chunks=completed_chunks+1,received_count=received_count+#{receivedCount} where run_id=#{runId} and status='RUNNING'
mapper.sql: o.observation_id observationId,o.connection_id connectionId,o.mapping_id mappingId,o.user_id userId,o.source_key sourceRecordKey,o.source_revision sourceRevision,o.fingerprint,o.business_date businessDate,o.source_timezone sourceTimezone,o.kind,o.normalized_status normalizedStatus,o.source_status sourceStatus,o.quality,o.source_duration_seconds sourceDurationSeconds,o.intervals_json intervalsJson,o.details_json detailsJson,o.sync_run_id syncRunId,o.received_at receivedAt,o.last_seen_at lastSeenAt,o.last_seen_run_id lastSeenRunId,o.is_current isCurrent,o.adapter_version adapterVersion
mapper.select: select from biz_feishu_observation o where o.connection_id=#{connectionId} and o.source_key=#{sourceRecordKey} and o.is_current=1 limit 1
select from biz_feishu_observation o where o.observation_id=#{observationId}
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_observation set is_current=0 where observation_id=#{observationId} and is_current=1
mapper.select: select ,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName from biz_feishu_observation o join biz_feishu_connection c on c.connection_id=o.connection_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=o.user_id where o.business_date between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo} and c.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and o.user_id=#{userId} and o.is_current=1 order by o.business_date desc,o.observation_id desc limit #{offset},#{pageSize}
mapper.sql: issue_id issueId,connection_id connectionId,run_id runId,observation_id observationId,external_id_hash externalIdHash,issue_code issueCode,status,resolution,resolved_by resolvedBy,created_at createdAt,resolved_at resolvedAt
mapper.select: select from biz_feishu_issue where connection_id=#{connectionId} order by issue_id desc limit 200
select from biz_feishu_issue where issue_id=#{issueId}
mapper.update: update biz_feishu_issue set status='RESOLVED',resolution=#{resolution},resolved_by=#{actorId},resolved_at=sysdate() where issue_id=#{issueId} and status='OPEN'
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_feishu_issue where connection_id=#{connectionId} and status='OPEN'

select validation_id validationId,connection_id connectionId,connection_version connectionVersion,case_type caseType,observation_id observationId,issue_id issueId,run_id runId,expected_result expectedResult,source_evidence sourceEvidence,local_result localResult,passed,reason,validated_by validatedBy,validated_at validatedAt from biz_feishu_validation where connection_id=#{connectionId} order by validation_id desc limit 100

select count(distinct v.case_type) from biz_feishu_validation v where v.connection_id=#{connectionId} and v.connection_version=#{version} and v.passed=1 and not exists(select 1 from biz_feishu_validation newer where newer.connection_id=v.connection_id and newer.connection_version=v.connection_version and newer.case_type=v.case_type and newer.validation_id > v.validation_id)
select count(*) from biz_feishu_reader_scope where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and user_id=#{userId} and enabled=1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_feishu_reader_scope(company_dept_id,user_id,enabled,granted_by,updated_at) values(#{companyDeptId},#{userId},#{enabled},#{actorId},sysdate()) on duplicate key update enabled=values(enabled),granted_by=values(granted_by),updated_at=sysdate()
mapper.select: select company_dept_id companyDeptId,user_id userId,enabled,granted_by grantedBy,updated_at updatedAt from biz_feishu_reader_scope where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId}
